category: premium file host (one-click hoster), retrieval target

free_tier.stated: Free tier is not published as a byte allowance; the site sells three paid tiers by daily traffic.

per_object_cap.stated: max file size 5 GB on Premium and 10 GB on Premium Pro per one reseller; not confirmed on the vendor site

retention.stated: not published in a reachable page

egress.terms: Traffic is the product: 20, 50 or 100 GB per day depending on tier, with 'no speed limits' claimed for all three.
egress.price_per_tb: no overage price; the tier is the lever

interface_detail: Part of the K2S family, which publishes an API at keep2share.cc/api/v2; FileBoom's own site did not confirm a separate endpoint.
tooling: browser and download managers; JDownloader 2 support is reported for the family
chaining: Only useful when the file is FileBoom-hosted; it is the most expensive per TiB of the K2S family for the same 100 GB/day.

limits.value: 5 GB on Premium, 10 GB on Premium Pro (reported)

limits_note: All numbers are reseller-reported; the vendor's own pricing page is client-rendered and returned no grid.
binding_note: Only Premium Max clears 1 TiB a month with room; the two cheaper tiers cap at 0.55 and 1.36 TiB.

identity_cost.detail: E-mail signup; card and crypto via resellers or the vendor checkout.

reliability_note: The family applies a hard daily counter; a missed day is not recoverable.
confidence_note: Four resellers agree on the 20/50/100 GB structure and within a few dollars on price, which is why the shape is recorded; the exact 30-day total needs the vendor checkout to become documented.

evidence.proved: table of Premium 20 GB, Pro 50 GB, Max 100 GB at $28.94/$35.94/$46.94 per month
'Daily traffic 50 GB / 20 GB'; 'Max file size 10 GB / 5 GB'

price_per_tb_month: USD 17.20 per TiB-month on Premium Max (USD 46.94 for 2.73 TiB); USD 26.8 on Premium Pro; USD 52.5 on Premium
notes: Included because the K2S family is one of the four host groups that actually appear on link sites in volume. Its per-TiB price is the worst of that group.

extras.price_ladder_reported: Premium USD 28.94 / 30 days (20 GB/day); Premium Pro USD 35.94 (50 GB/day); Premium Max USD 46.94 (100 GB/day), all reported by resellers because the vendor page is client-rendered
